detectors.message: RTL-forbidden directional class — use logical utilities (ms-/me-/ps-/pe-/text-start/text-end).
console statement — no-console is ESLint-enforced (TS-010); use logger.ts.
window.confirm() — use the ConfirmDialog molecule for destructive actions (FA-026).
Possible hardcoded secret — secrets belong in env/secret manager (SEC-004/SEC-017).
Raw error.message surfaced to users — route through sanitizeErrorMessage() (SEC-011/UX-024).
Possible hardcoded user-facing string in JSX — wrap with t() (I18N-001/002).
Unstable queryKey (fresh reference each render) — normalize/memoize (PERF-022).
